title: The Terminal of Sector Nine
author: Marguerite Sterling
blurb: Jude Halloran, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
